sentences.text: Today, we will talk about San Sebastian, a beautiful city in the north of Spain.
Part one, Introduction.
San Sebastian is a small but very famous city.
It is in the Basque country, close to the border with France.
The city is next to the Bay of Biscay, on the coast of the Atlantic Ocean.
San Sebastian is known for its beaches, food, culture, and film festival.
Part two, Beaches.
One of the most famous things about San Sebastian is its beaches.
The most popular beach is La Concha Beach.
It is shaped like a shell and is very beautiful.
People swim, sunbathe, and walk along the beach.
Another beach is Zuriola Beach.
This beach is famous for surfing.
Many young people and surfers from around the world come here.
Part three, Food San Sebastian is one of the best food cities in the world.
It has many Michelin star restaurants, but the most famous food is Pinchos.
Pinchos are small snacks, like tapas, served on bread with many toppings.
You can eat Pinchos in bars while drinking a small glass of wine or cider.
Popular Pinchos include bread with cheese and ham, anchovies with peppers, omelettes with potatoes.
Food in San Sebastian is simple but full of flavor.
Part four, Culture and Festivals.
San Sebastian has a strong Basque culture.
People speak both Spanish and Basque language.
The Basque culture is unique with its own traditions, music, and dances.
The city also hosts the San Sebastian International Film Festival every year in September.
It is one of the most important film festivals in Europe.
Many famous actors and directors visit the city at this time.
Part five, Old Town and City Life.
The Old Town of San Sebastian is called Parte Vieja.
It has small streets full of bars, shops, and restaurants.
It is a great place to try Pinchos and enjoy the local atmosphere.
The city also has beautiful parks and a lively port area.
You can walk up to Mount Urgul or Mount Ageldo to see amazing views of the bay in the city.
Part six, Weather and Nature.
San Sebastian has mild weather.
Summers are warm but not too hot.
Winters are cool and sometimes rainy.
The green hills and ocean make the city very beautiful.
Part seven, Fun Facts.
San Sebastian is also called Donastia in Basque.
It was named the European Capital of Culture in 2016.
The city has more Michelin stars per person than almost anywhere else in the world.
La Concha Beach is often called one of the most beautiful city beaches in Europe.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about San Sebastian Spain.
It is a city of beaches, delicious food, and rich culture.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
